info.name: Blogging Platform IV
info.description:
REST and GraphQL requests for the Blogging Platform IV lab (Spring Security, JWT, Google OAuth2, RBAC).

1. Start the app: .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run (dev profile, the ADMIN account is admin / Admin@12345).
2. Import this file and run the collection from top to bottom (Collection Runner). Every request has a test.
3. The collection sends the ADMIN token ({{adminToken}}) by default. Requests in the role, token and CORS folders choose their own token or none.
The 'Expired token' request signs a token with the dev secret of application-dev.properties, so it only gives 401 on the dev profile.
